$note: 第 3 層 · 六十星系（2026-10-12）：天府獨坐卯酉，《深造講義》p.73。

basis.quote: 是属于局面广大的老成持重

rules.text: 天府以獨坐卯酉最安定、保守：這兩宮不與紫微相會，沒有紫微干擾，保守的性格最完整。
rules.en: Tian Fu is at its most settled and conservative alone in Mao or You: these palaces don't meet Zi Wei, so without its interference the conservative character stays whole.

source.quote: 以独坐卯酉二宫时最为安定、保守

rules.text: 你的天府與祿存同宮：單是得祿，只是小心謹慎，局面還未算大。
rules.en: Your Tian Fu shares the palace with Lu Cun: having Lu alone makes for care and caution, not yet a wide scope.

source.quote: 尤其是与禄存同垣的天府，只不过是小心谨慎而巳

rules.text: 你的天府與祿存同宮，又會火鈴，成為露庫：就算有吉星，也喜歡在小處佔別人便宜。
rules.en: Your Tian Fu shares the palace with Lu Cun and meets Huo and Ling, an 'exposed vault': even with good stars, you tend to take small advantages of others.
rules.edit: 「主人奸詐」屬人格貶語，不用；保留「喜佔小便宜」。

source.quote: 亦主喜占别人的小便宜

rules.text: 對面遷移宮的武曲化祿，你的局面廣大，老成持重。
rules.en: Wu Qu opposite you is transformed by Lu: your scope is wide, and you carry it with mature steadiness.

source.quote: 则天府局面广大而且老成持重

rules.text: 對面遷移宮的武曲七殺與祿存同宮，你的局面廣大，老成持重。
rules.en: Wu Qu and Qi Sha opposite you share the palace with Lu Cun: your scope is wide, and you carry it with mature steadiness.

rules.text: 對面遷移宮的武曲化忌，你的格局最多只是小局面的謹慎。
rules.en: Wu Qu opposite you is in Obstruction, so at most your character is careful caution on a small scale.

source.quote: 充其量亦只是小局面的谨慎而已
